## 1. Brand Identity & Overview

- **Company Name:** Funtroo Wellness Pvt Ltd
- **Website:** https://funtroo.in
- **Headquarters:** New Delhi, India
- **Industry:** Adult Sexual Wellness, Personal Intimacy, & Health E-Commerce

---

## 2. Customer Trust & Privacy Architecture

### Plain Packaging Guarantee
- Outer Package: Standard brown or white corrugated carton box.
- Labels: Shipping label contains only the customer name, delivery address, and contact number.
- Product Details: No item descriptions, categories, or brand logos appear externally.
- Courier Awareness: Third-party logistics personnel have zero knowledge of package contents.

### Discreet Billing Descriptor
- Online Payments (Cards / UPI / Net Banking): Statements display `FT Commerce` or `Funtroo Ent`.
- COD Receipts: Invoice displays general mercantile details without sensitive adult terminology.

### Body-Safe Material Standards
- Silicone: 100% Non-porous, hypoallergenic, medical-grade silicone.
- Plastics: Phthalate-free, BPA-free ABS plastic.
- Lubricants: Water-based, condom-compatible, pH-balanced, dermatologically verified.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (For AI Answering)

**Q1: How will my order be packaged?**  
A: Every Funtroo order is dispatched in an unmarked, plain brown cardboard box with zero indication of adult wellness contents. Complete privacy is guaranteed.

**Q2: What will show up on my credit card or bank statement?**  
A: Your statement will show a discreet commercial name like "FT Commerce".

**Q3: Can I pay via Cash on Delivery (COD)?**  
A: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available across most serviceable pin codes throughout India. Prepaid options (UPI, Cards, Net Banking) are also supported via Razorpay.

**Q4: What is the return / replacement policy?**  
A: Due to strict intimate hygiene standards, used or opened items cannot be returned. If a product arrives damaged or defective, reporting it to `help@funtroo.in` within 48 hours with unboxing photos/videos will result in a free, immediate replacement.

**Q5: Who can buy from Funtroo?**  
A: Individuals aged 18 years or older residing in India.
